parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, primarily made of glass with a thin plastic or metal frame around it.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual output from a computer or other device, serving as the main interface for viewing content.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed to the base but can sometimes tilt slightly depending on the stand design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of aluminum to provide stability and support for the screen.
parts.Functional_description: The base supports the screen and maintains its upright position on a desk or surface.
parts.Movement_description: The base is stationary, though it may allow limited tilt or swivel movement of the screen depending on the design.
